latest.title: Building a Highly Available Web Application on AWS with Application Load Balancer & Auto Scaling
latest.description: Designed and deployed a highly available web application on AWS using Amazon EC2, Application Load Balancer, and Auto Scaling Group. This project demonstrates how AWS services work together to improve availability, automate recovery, and distribute traffic across multiple Availability Zones.

latest.title: From Information Systems to Cloud-Based Systems
latest.description: Using various data schemas and retail market information, we modeled new ways to analyze and organize products in warehouses, organizational areas, and distribution centers using AWS services. This allowed us to optimize storage per unit, streamline product location and organization lines, and, above all, prevent product accumulation, making each item more visible to maintain low stock levels and achieve complete inventory turnover.

latest.title: Everyone Taught Their Agent to Dream. Nobody Taught It to Remember Last Tuesday 😅
latest.description: Every agent memory product on the market is consolidation: many sessions crushed into a few durable rules. This is the other half, episodic retrieval where each Claude Code session stays its own searchable memory, built on S3 Vectors and Bedrock

latest.title: 🏆 One of the First 100 Builders Worldwide – AWS Builder Center Weekend Challenge
latest.description: I'm excited to share that I was selected as one of the first 100 participants worldwide to complete the AWS Builder Center Build an Always-On Agent Weekend Challenge, earning an official AWS Builder Center jacket! 🧥 For this challenge, I built the Morning Brief Agent, an autonomous AI agent powered by Amazon Bedrock (Nova Lite) that automatically generates personalised daily briefings using weather and task data. Huge thanks to the AWS Builder Center team for this amazing opportunity! 🚀

latest.title: Stop Reviewing PRs: Let AWS Bedrock Do It
latest.description: Stop manual code reviews! Build a serverless AI pipeline with AWS Bedrock, CodeBuild & CDK that automatically audits PRs and posts fixes.

latest.title: Fundamentos de IA y ML: Conceptos y Terminología
latest.description: En este artículo encontrarás los fundamentos que necesitas dominar para prepararte para la certificación AWS AI Practitioner (AIF-C01). Este es el primer artículo de una serie en la que compartiremos los temas clave del examen, explicados de forma sencilla para ayudarte a comprenderlos, recordarlos y aplicarlos con confianza. Ya sea que estés preparando tu certificación o simplemente quieras fortalecer tus conocimientos sobre Inteligencia Artificial en AWS, esta serie será una excelente guía de estudio.
